title.en: Neural Audio Codecs — EnCodec, SNAC, Mimi, DAC and the Semantic-Acoustic Split

hook: 2026 audio generation is almost all tokens. EnCodec, SNAC, Mimi, and DAC turn continuous waveforms into discrete sequences that a transformer can predict. The semantic-vs-acoustic token split — first-codebook as semantic, rest as acoustic — is the most important architectural shift since the Transformer for audio.
